### `r .row$display_name`

```{r}
.lb <- RES$leaderboard |> dplyr::filter(player == .row$player)
htmltools::div(
  class = "playercard",
  htmltools::span(class = "pill", sprintf("Rank %d of %d", .lb$rank, nrow(RES$leaderboard))),
  htmltools::span(class = "pill", sprintf("Score %s", format(.lb$total_score))),
  htmltools::span(class = "pill", sprintf("%d exact", .lb$exact_hits)),
  htmltools::span(class = "pill", sprintf("worst miss %d places", .lb$worst_miss)),
  htmltools::span(class = "pill pill-quiet",
                  sprintf("submitted %s", fmt_when(.row$submitted_at)))
)
```

```{r}
render_player_table(RES, .row$player)
```

<p class="note">▲ means the club is doing better than `r .row$display_name` predicted; ▼ means worse.</p>
